integrity: The finite classification is proved by a six-cell structural case split and independently replayed over all 216 profiles; serial dictatorship is implemented twice and CRE is cross-checked by top trading cycles against direct blocking-coalition core enumeration.
scientific_limitations: Complete only for three agents and three objects with strict complete preferences and uniform random priority; no larger-market or weak-preference classification is asserted.
title: Complete three-agent lottery-shape classification for random serial dictatorship
